decision.reason: [ev-4c42b6db5d61] is a single changelog line, "Native otlp ingestion support", that links to PR 10727. It names a feature and implies an addition, but it does not identify the concrete artifact (endpoint path, config key or flag). It also does not say whether the feature is on by default or must be turned on, or what changes for an operator who does nothing. The open applicability aspect can't be written from this text. It needs the PR or the OTLP ingestion docs, stating the endpoint and how it is enabled.
